text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus trains hard for the Mile 
Championship, but Hishi Akebono has grown 
at an even more astonishing pace.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On race day, Biko Pegasus becomes 
intimidated by Hishi Akebono's newfound 
power. Just then, an action movie actor 
shows up to cheer her on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having gained confidence from carrying a 
lead role, the actor encourages Biko 
Pegasus. As long as that fiery blood pumps 
through our veins, we can get back up as 
many times as it takes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus would never give up. For upon 
her back rested the wings of dreams.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Energized by heartfelt cheers, Biko 
Pegasus rises once more. With the title of 
the Sprinting World's New Hero on the 
line, a clash of justice between best 
friends begins.
